_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md)

pit_profile.why: Accenture: global consulting and outsourcing leader across five operating groups with $25.0B bookings in FY10; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not

theme_watch.reason: Live: Accenture's own FY2010 10-K names off-shore providers, 'particularly in India or China ... often at highly competitive prices and on more aggressive contractual terms', among its competitors and says competition from lower-cost locations 'has put downward pressure on the prices we can charge for our services ... and is likely to continue to do so', while its own Global Delivery Network grew to 116,000+ people. The stock trades at 16.9x FY11E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (OFFSHORE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing offshore substitution for ACN specifically.

classification.quality_note: Accenture: global consulting and outsourcing leader across five operating groups with $25.0B bookings in FY10; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.51x; +41% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.68; conservative 2yr +26%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY03-FY10, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +19.4%/yr (latest guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 8.9-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +19.4%/yr (FY03-FY10 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +28.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY10); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: ACN (retrospective, 2011-08-05) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.51x (26.6% downside to Bear $42 / +52.1% upside to Bull $87) | Adj composite 2.83 vs market 2.15: gap +0.68 [UNDERVALUED] | +41% above the EPP floor $41 (12x FY11E $3.38) | Conservative 2-yr case: +25.5% total (+12.7%/yr) | At 16.9x FY11E the 15% hurdle price $76 sits at or below the BASE case; consulting +17% LC in Q3, FY11 guided +14-15% LC; offshore competition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
